source.notes: ISC Class XI school quarterly examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Quarterly Examination - 2017-2018', 'Physics', 'Std. : XI', 'Time : 2 Hrs. + 15 min.', 'F. M. : 50'; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 135 = 2 h + 15 min as printed (the 15 min is probably reading time). The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Part I: Q1 (A) five 1-mark MCQs and Q1 B ten 1-mark short answers; Part II: Q2–Q13. Q10 and Q13 have internal OR choices (each alternative is its own entry, labels (a)/(b) assigned by the editor), so the pack's marks add up to 58 against F.M. 50 (50 when one alternative of each is counted). Vector arrows, unit vectors, powers, subscripts and fractions were rebuilt from the page images as Unicode/inline text. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
